sections.label: The work
sections.statement: The discipline of a global brand, <t>built one market at a time.</t>
body: Twenty-five years in business development, strategy and operations across fitness, wellness, sport and hospitality: strategy consulting at EY and Cordial, strategy and business development for SATS and Health & Fitness Nordic, then ten years building Barry’s in the Nordics as CEO and partner.
Today, a partner in Barry’s Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland, founding partner of Stockholm Leisure Partners, and a board member of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.
<t>[A personal note in Johan’s own words to follow: where the sport began, and why fitness.]</t>

sections.label: The defining chapter
sections.title: Barry’s <t>in the Nordics.</t>
sections.body: A boutique fitness brand from Los Angeles, brought to Stockholm in 2016 and built studio by studio. In January 2022 the Swedish and Norwegian companies merged into the region’s largest boutique operator; the work then moved on to Spain, Switzerland and Finland.

sections.label: In his words
sections.title: From his <t>LinkedIn.</t>

items.t: Barry’s Helsinki is open.
items.q: “So proud to share that Barry’s Helsinki is officially open 🇫🇮🔥 Huge thanks to everyone who made this happen — it’s been an incredible team effort! See you on the treadmill.”

items.t: Elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy.
items.q: “Jag är både stolt och ödmjuk över att i helgen ha blivit vald till ledamot i förbundsstyrelsen för Svensk Innebandy.”
items.s: LinkedIn, July 2026 · “Both proud and humble to have been elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy this weekend.”

items.t: A new board, a new season.
items.q: “Inspirerande start med nya förbundsstyrelsen och Sportkontoret! Ser fram emot att bidra till utvecklingen av svensk innebandy – och inte minst till att stärka elitinnebandyn sportsligt, kommersiellt och organisatoriskt. Let’s go!”
items.s: LinkedIn, September 2026 · “Looking forward to contributing to Swedish floorball, and not least to strengthening the elite game sportingly, commercially and organisationally.”

items.t: Where luxury lives now.
items.q: “Barry’s x Balenciaga 🙌” — sharing Daniel Rabinovich: “Luxury used to be defined entirely by what you wore to a fancy dinner. Today, it’s defined by where you sweat.”

steps.d: Demand, competition, sites and price points, read as an operator rather than as a consultant: what will the floor look like on a Tuesday morning?
A brand entering a country lives or dies by its local partner. The structure, the licence and the people are agreed before the site.
Site, team, product and launch, run to the brand’s standard. A first studio that opens strong carries the ones that follow.
Profitable growth, studio by studio: the standards and reporting that let a concept scale and, when the time comes, merge or sell.
